name: audited
definition: Subject passed the named audit on the given date; evidence hash required.
data-schema:
audited-data = { ? audit: tstr, ? date: tstr, * tstr => any }   ; recommended layout, not enforced
; the attestation MUST carry evidence: bstr .size 32
title: Audited
description: The evidence field (SHA-256 of the audit report) is REQUIRED; every consumer rejects an audited attestation without it as attestation_schema_invalid. Because it carries evidence it is audit-backed and may live up to 400 days.
subject: Agent ID that passed the audit
attestation-schema:
attestation = {
  subject: agent-id,
  issuer: agent-id,                      ; MUST equal the envelope signer
  claim: uri,
  data: { * tstr => any },
  ? evidence: bstr .size 32,
  ? evidence-uri: uri,
  id: bstr .size 16,
}
agent-id = bstr .size 32
uri = tstr
data-checked-by: Evidence presence by every consumer; the data map is not checked.
